why: In A the two circles sit in opposite corners; in B they move to the middle and overlap. So the two pentagons of C must move to the middle and overlap, keeping their own direction: one pointing down and one pointing up. That is option 1. Options 2 and 3 do not overlap, and options 4 and 5 bring in a circle that is not in C.
trick: If the shapes only move, they must keep the same size, number and direction; only their position changes.
